notes:
### Dorcel Playback

- Removed the fixed 35-second InputStream Adaptive live delay and returned Dorcel playback to the normal ISA live-edge behavior after long-run testing showed that Dorcel usually exposes only about 20–25 seconds of playlist history.
- Normal 15/20/25-second source windows and media-sequence resets remain conservative and do not trigger unnecessary restarts.

### Upstream Outage Recovery

- Confirmed Dorcel HTTP 404 manifest failures now immediately attempt to resolve and validate a fresh website session instead of allowing the broken player to accumulate long A/V sync debt.
- A single timeout or SSL/read error does not restart playback immediately. The failure is rechecked first, and recovery starts only when the outage is confirmed.
- If a fresh Dorcel session is also unavailable, the tool enters a controlled upstream-outage state instead of creating a restart loop. Fresh sessions are rechecked at approximately 10-second intervals and playback is reopened cleanly as soon as a valid source returns.
- Outage monitoring can remain active after EOF for up to 10 minutes so a temporary Dorcel backend failure can recover without ending the test immediately.

### Diagnostics

- Dorcel summaries now include upstream-outage counters and recovery statistics so long tests show how many outages occurred, how many recovered automatically and the longest measured outage duration.
- Existing SOURCE_WINDOW diagnostics, Wi-Fi diagnostics, stall IDs and handoff timing remain available.

### Important

- The existing planned hourly Dorcel token handoff remains unchanged.
- Auto Channels Check, Site/IPTV behavior, One Channel, automatic log saving, Save Log Only, Shutdown/Sleep, Check Lock and AlarmClock/watchdog remain otherwise unchanged.
